description: Create, replace and delete files in one deploy that goes live immediately. Use utf8 for text and base64 for small binary files. For large or many files use start_upload instead. Allowed: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, text, XML, SVG, web fonts, images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, ICO) and PDF; binary files must really be what their extension says.

content.description: File content. Text as-is for utf8, or base64 for binary files.

delete.description: Paths to remove in the same deploy.

message.description: Short description of the change, kept in the deploy history.

name: write_files
